reference_inconsistencies.issue: Toe formula uses epsilon5 while the lower-element gauge is SG6; toe-force reconstruction below the last gauge is not disclosed.
SG2 = 4.4 tf and SG3 = 1.0 tf at 40 tf nominal load produce a negative upper-element gradient, but the friction table gives positive 0.60 tf/m²; sign treatment is unexplained.
Summary labels appear to reverse peak top-plate and pile-top displacement identities relative to source table.
Planned loading schedule/repeated steps differ from the consolidated recorded table; the protocol must not be copied to P2.
Narratives conflict on lower-element failure; they are not usable as P2 failure evidence.
Reference head/plate/toe endpoints are model/boundary values not supplied by P2 gauge readings.
Polynomial degree/coefficients and full equivalent-curve construction protocol are not disclosed.

implementation_rules: Merge loading/unloading within each load-response channel in chronological stage order.
Upper/lower strain can share one selectable plot; upper/lower depth lines remain separated across cell.
Keep depth on the vertical axis increasing downward; no 90-degree axis rotation is needed for force/friction profiles.
Preserve actual signed values and source stage identities, including initial/final zero-load difference.
Do not copy the reference's cropped axes, incomplete legends, smoothed overshoot or unmeasured boundary points.
Unsupported graph families require explicit missing-input explanations, not fabricated curves.
